description: The seven event categories of AN-16-442 v8 section 6.1 / JHEP 11 (2017) 047 section 6 in the AN order, with the paper convention for the production discriminants: D' = 1/(1 + c' P_bkg/P_sig) recomputed from the raw MELA probabilities stored by h4l_select (analysis_v3/common/python/h4l_categories.py, 'discriminants' block), working point D' > 0.5 (equivalently P_sig/P_bkg > c'); VH-hadronic: D'_WH > 0.5 or D'_ZH > 0.5.  Adopted by the user on 2026-09-25 (stage-4b MC optimization, production_v3/tmp/category_opt/): the constants minimize (sigma(mu_VBF)/sigma_v1)^2 + (sigma(mu_VH)/sigma_v1)^2 with mu_ggH profiled (Asimov Fisher information of category x final state x (m4l_refit, D_bkg^kin) yields, 118 < m4l_refit < 130 GeV, 20 fb^-1); the AN MELA-only working points of cat_v1 left VH-hadronic empty with the MELA-normalized discriminants.  Jets pT > 30 GeV, |eta| < 4.7, cleaned from the selected leptons, the candidate's leptons and the selected FSR photons; b tags DeepJet medium (|eta| < 2.4); additional leptons: selected leptons outside the candidate.

discriminants.convention: D' = 1 / (1 + c0 * (m4l / m_ref)^p * P_bkg / P_sig); m4l = the unrefitted candidate mass (branch m4l); D' = -1 where undefined (wrong jet multiplicity or a non-positive probability); category requirement D' > working point (0.5)

provenance.inputs: h4l_select v3 scan, SR rows of the MC samples; Z+X proxy from the DY/TTBar MC CR rows

expected_precision_20fb.model: Asimov Fisher, category x final state x (1 GeV m4l_refit x 10 signal-quantile D_bkg^kin bins), 118-130 GeV, 20 fb^-1

provenance.validation: h4l_categories.category_index with proposed_discriminants.compute reproduces the optimization's categories for all 184453 MC rows in 105-140 GeV
